$comment: Reviewed Electronegativity findings accepted by the CI gate (scripts/electronegativity.mjs; specs/ci-gates.feature.md). Keyed by check id + repo-relative file + trimmed source line. Every entry needs a one-line rationale and accepts exactly `count` findings (default 1): a duplicated line or a stale entry fails the gate.

accepted.rationale: Middle-click opens reach the app-wide setWindowOpenHandler, which always denies the window and opens externally only allowlisted URLs on a trusted gesture (verified with a real middle-click: no window, no in-window navigation); disabling Auxclick adds nothing.

Reviewed: the sandboxed preload exposes only the frozen fixed-channel invoke bridge (ipc-transport.spec.ts; e2e renderer-has-no-node-or-ipc-globals); Semgrep renderer-bridge-outside-preload keeps contextBridge/ipcRenderer confined to it.
Reviewed: reached only when resolveExternalOpen allows the URL (scheme allowlist + trusted input gesture, security-policy.spec.ts), pinned by policy/register unit tests and the external-url e2e.

False positive: the scanner cannot evaluate the non-literal value; it is APP_CSP from security-policy.spec.ts, strict per test app-csp-is-strict and enforced end to end by e2e boots-under-strict-csp-without-violations.
